dataQualityAmendmentBeforeResults.handling: Permit only this exact source gap, never interpolate. No new entry from a signal across the gap. Existing simulated positions use the first available open for adverse gaps. Holding limits use elapsed hours. H4 groups missing any constituent hour are discarded. Simulated protective stops are local instructions, not exchange trailing orders (which were cancelled during this event). Every other gap remains an error.

protocol.commonFilters: Only completed H4 candles: EMA20 > EMA50, close > EMA50, EMA50 rising over 3 H4 bars. H1 EMA50 > EMA200 and close > EMA200 rising over 24 H1 bars. Stop distance >= 0.72% of signal close. Six-hour cooldown after exits. Long-only spot.
protocol.confirmed: Original T1/T2/T3 entry plus common filters.

reclaim.T1: Close recrosses above EMA20 after previous close <= previous EMA20; EMA20>EMA50; bullish candle.
reclaim.T2: Previous close <= previous EMA20, current low touches EMA20, close above EMA20 and open; EMA20>EMA50; RSI45..65.
reclaim.T3: Previous close broke prior Donchian20; current low retests channel level within 0.5 previous ATR; close above level and open.

protocol.exitTiming: Protective stops use completed candle closes and ATR, apply only next candle, never move downward. No same-candle retroactive stop. Break-even includes estimated fees and slippage. Entry remains next-open.
protocol.ranking: Seven candidates per family (six new plus current control); rank across 18 development cells, three assets x six half-years. Score = median net return - 0.25 worst candle-close DD. Adequate: >=120 trades total, >=20 per asset, at least 12 of18 cells have >=5 trades. Freeze one highest eligible winner per family, require score above control; tie by ID. No final data in ranking.
protocol.adoption: Freeze development winner before validation. Adopt for research only if validation improves at least 2/3 assets and mean return, and is net-positive on at least 2/3 assets. Otherwise retain control. Do not use final results to change selection or adoption.
protocol.claim: New round explicitly requested after v2. Earlier trials and reused final periods remain part of the research history; no independent-validation claim, no guaranteed profit and no automatic operational approval. One preregistered batch, no second search based on the results.
